run_pseudo_labelling: run pseudo-labelling of audio data using a pretrained Whisper model for distillation preparation
compute_wer_metrics: compute word error rate metrics on predicted and reference transcriptions with normalization
pseudo_label_dataset_splits: pseudo-label multiple dataset splits sequentially and save transcriptions to CSV files
build_data_collator_padding: build a data collator that dynamically pads audio inputs and label sequences for batched inference
push_transcriptions_hub: push pseudo-labelled dataset with transcriptions to a Hugging Face Hub repository
